headline: Infrastructure axis launches and the PSI hero gains an arc gauge with an annotated crisis timeline.
fieldNotes: The week added a new way to group coins: an Infrastructure axis that tags Liquity and M0 derivatives by the protocol they run on, replacing the older lineage fields. Four M0 wrappers and USDat arrived alongside it. The Stability Index gained annotated crisis events, exit liquidity moved to a best-path model, and Telegram delivery was hardened against rate limits. The treasury exposure page was retired.

summary.label: Infrastructure axis
summary.description: New filter dimension lets users browse stablecoins by underlying protocol: Liquity v1/v2 and M0 tagged across 25 coins, replacing the deprecated protocol-lineage fields.

summary.label: Stability intelligence
summary.description: PSI page ships an arc gauge hero with annotated crisis events from COVID Crash to BTC ATH, plus hardened non-USD depeg replay for BRZ, TRYB, and commodity pegs.

summary.label: Safety Scores redesign
summary.description: Grade-grouped card grid, a systemic risk headline ranked by dependent TVL, and entrance animations.

summary.label: Best-path exit model
summary.description: Exit liquidity replaces the blend with a best-path model and diversification premium (backstop methodology v3.7); Uniswap V2 and V4 pools split from the generic bucket.

summary.label: Live reserve adapters
summary.description: Abracadabra adapter for MIM cauldron collateral, a Lista adapter, live configs for seven more coins, and USDT reserves upgraded to Q4 2025 attestation data, reaching 136 coins.

summary.label: Broader coverage
summary.description: Seven new stablecoins (USDat, wM, USDnr, USDK, XO Cash, evaUSDC, evaUSDT) bring the dashboard to 194 tracked coins; RAI retired to the cemetery.

summary.label: Navigation & pages
summary.description: Redesigned /telegram page, changelog week nav with scroll-spy, refined sidebar signals, and the treasury exposure page retired.

summary.label: Pipeline hardening
summary.description: Telegram rate-limit handling and HTML fixes, 100+ audit remediation fixes across four merge streams, blacklist v3.7 enrichment, and mint-burn D1 query batching.
